Guidance & outlook: The company delivers end to end solution from engineering to procurement to execution, commissioning and long term maintenance support.
Profit before tax increases to 345% YOY to 7.19 crore from 1.61 crore in H2 FY2025 this reflects improved operational efficiency and better profitability.

Our strong order visibility, healthy order pipeline supported by long term growth, consistent execution and delivery capability, experienced leadership, end to end EPC capabilities and an asset light model.
